name_reason: Prefix data_fd2_battle_ and descriptor summon_anim_variant_c match the host fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial and all sibling globals (..._variant_c_5slot_x_coord_array etc.). 'angle_accumulator' correctly conveys the per-tick scalar accumulator that feeds the radial sin/cos position compute and ramps +6/-6 to open/close the ring. No Ghidra-address residue: '_c' is the variant letter (domain ID), not a hex address suffix. Name is regular, consistent, and accurate; no churn warranted.
purpose: Radial-ring radius accumulator for the variant-C 5-slot radial summon animation: the byte value used as the radius multiplier in the per-slot cos/sin position compute, and reused as a scratch sprite-id in the state-4/5 per-slot blit phase.
logic_summary: Single owner fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial @ 0x26E39 (11 byte-wide xrefs, no callers/writers elsewhere). Lifecycle: state-0 INIT writes 0 (00026ecf) before any read; state-3 reads it (00026f33 MOVZX) as the source for y_coord[4]; state-6 resets to 0x2A=42 (00026f67); radial-blit states 1/2/7/8 read it (00026fcf/00027021 MOVZX) as the radius multiplier in x=sweep+acc*cos(angle) and y=acc*sin(angle)*1.2+30, then state-2 adds 6 (000270f0) / state-8 subtracts 6 (00027106) to open/close the ring; states 4/5 reuse it as a scratch sprite-id (00027120 store 4 when frame<0; 000271b7 store frame-counter low byte; 00027127/00027166 MOVZX reads).
element_semantics: Single unsigned 8-bit scalar. Dual role: (1) radial-ring radius multiplier driving the sin/cos position math (ramped +6/-6, reset 0x2A), (2) transient scratch sprite-id during the state-4/5 per-slot blit. Every access is byte-width; every read uses MOVZX (zero-extend).
comment_original_issue: The src comment was accurate on the mutations (init 0, +6/-6 ramp, reset 0x2A, scratch sprite-id reuse) but omitted the core USE of the byte: the radius multiplier fed into the per-slot cos/sin position compute in the radial-blit phase. As written it read as if the accumulator is only mutated, never consumed.
notes: All 11 xrefs verified inside fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial via disassembly; on-disk image confirmed db 0h (value 0x0) so zero-bss is exact. Ghidra annotation moved from PRE_COMMENT (forbidden for data plates per project rule) to PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline Java API; stray PRE cleared; verified PLATE_NOW populated, PRE_NOW null. is_const=false because the game writes this byte in states 0/2/4/5/6/8.
